name: dev-fast
note: One cold-preroll pod in under 15 s of wall clock. The pod is the FIRST program (at:0), so the worker sees an all-ad playlist immediately and the extension can mint a clean source and reveal a real picture before the 5 s pod ends. Pixels start at 3 s, after the measured 1.1-1.4 s reveal, so they test the cover, not the detector's latency. No stall: the native element stays healthy, so pod end takes the ordinary native-handoff path instead of the 3 s handback-wait ceiling that dev-handback-wait measures; --no-ext shows ad blue at the same instants and prints RESULT FAIL via controlVerdict, so the PASS cannot be vacuous. tailMs=2000 keeps the run alive until the worker's ~1 s pod-end poll and the handoff row are in the ring.
